task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York, get the status for flight CA1234, and book an economy seat for John Doe on that flight. After that, look up the gate information for the flight and publish a gate board notice to user_123 via email, then set a reminder for the flight departure and send me a push alert.

user_input.query: Could you please check the current time in the America/New_York timezone and get the status for flight CA1234? After that, I need you to book an economy seat for John Doe on that flight. Once the booking is done, look up the flight's gate information and publish a high priority gate board notice to user_123 using the email channel. Finally, please set a reminder for the flight departure with the title "Flight Departure Reminder" and send me a push alert so I don't forget.
